light_profile.bulge_light_method: integrated SBbulge/(SBdisk+SBbulge) light fraction, jointly scaled to catalogue L3.6; no radial extrapolation

shared_physical_settings.gas_mass_convention: Mgas = gas_ML * helium_factor * catalogue MHI; helium included exactly once; molecular gas omitted
shared_physical_settings.disk_profile_normalisation: exact mono_SPARC_RAR.py luminosity-weighted mean; integrated disk mass checked against mean_ML * Ldisk
shared_physical_settings.a_proxy_definition: Rdisk/0.85 kpc; exploratory Miyamoto-Nagai geometry correspondence
shared_physical_settings.mass_quadrature: independent Gauss-Hermite lognormal gas and bulge nuisance priors; reported mean and inverse-weighted-CDF 16/84 percentiles are prior summaries, not probability-conditioned posteriors
shared_physical_settings.selection_policy: invalid source cells and invalid light/profile cells are retained and flagged; this diagnostic does not exclude galaxies or alter monotonicity probabilities
shared_physical_settings.limitations: surface-brightness profiles are integrated only over tabulated radial coverage; disk/bulge component ratio is jointly scaled to catalogue total L3.6; screen is not a theory test
